results.question: Show daily sales for the last seven days
results.sql: SELECT CAST(o.order_date AS VARCHAR) AS "label", SUM(o.net_amount) AS "value" FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-12-25' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.order_date ORDER BY o.order_date ASC

results.question: Show sales by region as a pie chart
results.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS "label", SUM(o.net_amount) AS "value" FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON r.region_id = c.region_id JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name ORDER BY "value" DESC

results.question: Show monthly traffic for 2025
results.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', session_date) AS "label", COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM sessions WHERE session_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.question: Show the top 10 customers by sales
results.sql: SELECT c.customer_name AS "label", SUM(oi.net_amount) AS "value" FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY "value" DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: Show sales for December 15, 2025
results.sql: SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS "label", SUM(net_amount) AS "value" FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date = '2025-12-15' GROUP BY order_date

results.question: Show sales by product category for 2025
results.sql: SELECT t1.category_name AS "label", SUM(t3.net_amount) AS "value" FROM categories AS t1 JOIN products AS t2 ON t1.category_id = t2.category_id JOIN order_items AS t3 ON t2.product_id = t3.product_id JOIN orders AS t4 ON t3.order_id = t4.order_id WHERE t4.status = 'completed' AND t4.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t4.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY t1.category_name ORDER BY "value" DESC
